title: Master Intel Synthetic Demonstration
description: A bundled offline demonstration showing player dossiers, evidence coverage, timing ranges, and comparison gates without making claims about real professional players.

provenance.statement: All player names and statistics in this pack are fictional and exist only to demonstrate the product workflow.

opening_preferences: Third-base plans protected by mobile scouting
Stable Robo transitions when the opponent compresses ground production
economy_tendencies: Worker production is preserved until direct timing evidence appears
Third-base timing is delayed rather than abandoned when production information becomes stale
production_tendencies: Adds Gateway throughput before exposed economy on high-pressure branches
Uses Robo production as the stable-ground anchor
aggression_profile: Uses early units to force movement and obtain information rather than seek mandatory damage
Disengages when the pressure has already forced the desired response
map_adaptations: Earlier reinforcement access on wide third-base layouts
Delays fragile third locations when travel and retreat geometry are unfavorable

opening_preferences: Tank geometry when the opponent's ground power spike is known
economy_tendencies: Uses visible pressure to make economic investment safer
Stops worker growth only when immediate survival or a decisive timing requires it
production_tendencies: Production increases are aligned with a movement or map-control objective
Avoids adding expensive capability without a scouting reason
aggression_profile: Threatens multiple lanes without donating the first pressure force
Treats mobility as a way to tax attention and reinforcement
map_adaptations: Uses air corridors to widen the opponent's defensive footprint
Chooses Tank lines according to reinforcement and retreat paths

opening_preferences: Larva allocation follows the verified opponent power spike
Creep and Overlord information before large Drone cycles
Defensive units preserved as a bridge back to economy
economy_tendencies: Drone cycles are compressed when the next opponent production cycle is unresolved
Returns to economy quickly after the attack is conclusively held
production_tendencies: Uses larva as optionality until the opponent's capability is classified
Adds composition technology only when the existing army cannot cover the next state
aggression_profile: Uses Ling movement to tax attention and reveal defensive allocation
Avoids converting a successful threat into an unnecessary all-in
map_adaptations: Prioritizes creep and warning time on wide defensive footprints
Uses run-by lanes when the opponent's core army becomes positionally committed
